consequence.statement: Control-plane ServiceMonitors now authenticate via a Secret through `authorization` and the kube-root-ca.crt ConfigMap, and the chart creates a long-lived, non-expiring kubernetes.io/service-account-token Secret named <prometheus service account>-token by default.
consequence.remediation: Set prometheus.serviceAccount.createTokenSecret to false and configure `authorization` for each component if you prefer to manage the credential yourself.

assertion.statement: The chart adds prometheus.serviceAccount.createTokenSecret (default true), which renders a long-lived service-account-token Secret so the control-plane ServiceMonitors can use `authorization` and the kube-root-ca.crt ConfigMap instead of bearerTokenFile/caFile.
